title: Spoken voice (voice clone)
description: Speaks the text in a selected voice using a reference recording. The chosen voice sample is not connected to the song's audible mix.

parameters.name: file
parameters.label: Voice sample
parameters.doc: A recording of the voice to clone. Keep it in the project. Non-WAV files are converted internally when needed.

parameters.name: text
parameters.label: Text to speak
parameters.doc: The new words this block speaks. Write [pause 800 ms] or [pause 1.2 s] between words to leave a silence there (at most 10 s each, 60 s together): the voice is made per piece and the silence is put between them.

parameters.name: model
parameters.label: Model
parameters.doc: Qwen3 requires the reference transcript; XTTS and Chatterbox do not.

parameters.name: language
parameters.label: Language
parameters.doc: Language code supported by the selected model. Qwen3 does not support Dutch or Flemish.

parameters.name: reference_text
parameters.label: Sample transcript
parameters.doc: What the voice sample says. Qwen3 needs this, unless auto detect is enabled.

parameters.name: auto_detect
parameters.label: Auto detect sample transcript
parameters.doc: When enabled, Whisper transcribes the sample if Qwen3 needs a transcript and none was entered.

parameters.name: channels
parameters.doc: auto: stereo when an input or the source is stereo, otherwise mono; mono: sum to mono; stereo: always two channels (a mono sound is copied to both).

parameters.name: engine
parameters.label: Engine
parameters.doc: Where this block is rendered, overriding the project: local, faer or faer-else-local. Empty: the project route decides. Asking for faer without a Faer connection stops the build with an error; it never falls back to local. The voice model is chosen with the model parameter.

needs: A reference recording of the voice (parameter file).
The voice-clone plugin and its model.
